name: Halloran drop
text: A sealed cargo pod on a slow drift, a Halloran tag on the hatch and no ship in sight. Somebody's drop, waiting for somebody's pickup.

outcomes.result: Machine parts, and cash in a coffee tin. The Hallorans count their drops. They'll know who came by.
The pod was wired, as the family's pods are. Somebody will feel it tomorrow, but the tin came too.

choices.label: Call it in
choices.result: You read the tag out on the family's band. A voice says thank you, which the Hallorans never say. Someone will remember.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.result: Not your drop. Not your problem.
